title: A kb-worker subagent of a hand-made worktree records no work rows, so cost and rework read zero and land warns
goal: A kb-worker subagent started in a hand-made worktree under .claude/worktrees records its prompts as work rows (the capture hooks run for it, or the worker brief starts them), so cost --rework reports work for the item and land stops warning 'landed with no work rows' for normal worker runs, with a test named worker_capture_hooks_run_in_worktree. Evidence: SP-tt4tibyn and the other sprints of the night show zero prompts and the warning on every land.
repro_reason: the capture hooks of a subagent started in a hand-made worktree cannot be observed from a repro; the text match shows the worker definition does not name the capture requirement
